show.description: A fiery small-town girl, Bani, storms into a rich CEO Parth’s life after a hilarious misunderstanding leads to a forced marriage. While Parth hides his true identity, their fake relationship slowly turns real amid family drama, betrayal, power struggles, and corporate intrigue. As enemies plot against them, Bani proves her strength, wins respect, and ultimately stands as both Parth’s equal and the true powerhouse behind it all.
